dynamic_action_template_design.issue: A localized button label is interpolated as a grammar fragment for retry, cancel, and remove. Some languages need a different verb form or sentence frame per action.
suggested_design: Replace dynamic {action} with three localized plural message keys selected by the finite action value.

Example English keys: Failed to retry {count} transfers. First error: {label}: {message}; Failed to cancel {count} transfers. First error: {label}: {message}; Failed to remove {count} transfers. First error: {label}: {message}.
Translators can then restructure each full sentence naturally. Keep opaque {label} and {message} values unchanged.
